title: Proper fibre idempotent image over a locally Noetherian base
statement: Let f:X→S be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], S locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and s∈S. For each idempotent e in Γ(X_s,O) on its scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre], there is an open neighbourhood U of s and t∈Γ(f⁻¹U,O_X) whose pullback along X_s→X is e.

proof.text: Identify X_0 with the usual scheme-theoretic fibre using Ideal.quotEquivOfEq for m^1=m, the induced Spec isomorphism, pullback.map and pullback symmetry. The resulting isomorphism commutes with projection to X. Pull the given idempotent e back along it, then obtain v in the formal-fibre section inverse limit using formalFibre_idempotent_limit.

Apply formal_functions_stalk_structureSheaf to identify the completed pushforward structure-sheaf module stalk with the formal-fibre section limit. Pull v back through its inverse. The first limit projection composed with this isomorphism is linear over the completed local ring, hence over the original local ring.

The local stalk ring is Noetherian by Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.Noetherian, so its maximal ideal is finitely generated. Prove that maximal-ideal scalars kill the zeroth formal-fibre section module using evalₐ_of and the quotient scalar map. In completion_image_mod_one choose x whose quotient modulo m agrees with the completed element. AdicCompletion.pow_smul_top_eq_ker_eval shows their difference lies in m times the completed module, which the zeroth projection kills by linearity. Their zeroth images therefore agree.

Represent x by a germ of a section t on f⁻¹U using TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq. The fibre projection has image over s, so every fibre point lies over f⁻¹U. Use the formal-functions germ formula to show t restricts to the chosen idempotent on X_0. The projection-compatible isomorphism X_0≅X_s gives the desired equality on X_s by appLE composition and injectivity of pullback along an isomorphism. No idempotence of t is asserted.

lean.statement: theorem proper_fibre_idempotent_image_noetherian {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (s : S) (e : Γ(f.fiber s, ⊤)) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : ∃ (U : S.Opens), s ∈ U ∧ ∃ (h : (⊤ : (f.fiber s).Opens) ≤ (f.fiberι s) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)) (t : Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U)), (f.fiberι s).appLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊤ h t = e
